title: Note to staff: Sam Altman says OpenAI seeks a DOD deal with exemptions for cases like domestic surveillance and wants to "help de-escalate" DOD-Anthropic fight (Keach Hagey/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Keach Hagey / Wall Street Journal: Note to staff: Sam Altman says OpenAI seeks a DOD deal with exemptions for cases like domestic surveillance and wants to “help de-escalate” DOD-Anthropic fight — Anthropic has spent weeks at odds with the Pentagon over the scope of how its Claude AI tools can be used
